nodes.title: Character 1 | Griddle
widgets_values: A newly invented Afro-Caribbean barbecue dad, age 48, short and broad with a natural soft belly and sturdy arms. Deep warm-brown skin, round cheeks, dark brown eyes, short tight black curls with gray at the temples, and a neatly cropped salt-and-pepper beard. A plain brick-red cotton barbecue apron ending above the knees over a cream short-sleeve T-shirt, dark navy work trousers, orange terrycloth wristbands and dark brown lace-up ankle boots. No hat, jewelry, utensils or printed writing. Warm easy grin and a grounded, friendly heavyweight presence.

Griddle plants both boots, twists his torso and thrusts one open orange-cuffed palm toward the right, releasing a compact orange-and-gold flame ball. The free hand guards his chest. Keep the fire close to the forward palm so the game can launch a separate projectile; preserve the entire body and both feet inside the sprite cell.
The grill is hot. Your winning streak is toast.

nodes.title: Character 2 | Rivet
widgets_values: A newly invented South Asian workshop dad, age 46, tall with a lean muscular build, medium-brown skin, a long face, deep-set dark eyes, a broad nose, wavy black hair brushed back and a short black beard flecked with gray. Plain indigo mechanic coveralls with sleeves rolled to the elbows, a simple copper-brown leather belt and subtle copper-brown wrist straps, with scuffed steel-gray work boots. No tools, goggles, hat, logos or hanging equipment. Calm half-smile and straight relaxed posture.

Rivet draws both bracers together at the waist and drives one palm toward the right, launching a tight cyan magnetic pulse with three small copper fragments orbiting its center. Keep the effect near the palm, the other arm guarding the body and every limb fully inside the sprite cell. No large floating tools or duplicated arms.
I fix everything. Your stance is next.

nodes.title: Character 3 | Tempo
widgets_values: A newly invented East Asian music-teacher mother, age 38, compact athletic build, light warm-olive skin, a heart-shaped face, dark brown eyes and a short asymmetric auburn-red bob tucked behind one ear. A plain magenta zip track jacket worn open over an ivory T-shirt, slim midnight-blue trousers, cream high-top sneakers, simple violet fabric wristbands and small unbranded rounded headphones resting at her collar without a hanging cable. No instrument, makeup glamour, printed words or logos. An amused confident smile and light, lively posture.

Tempo pivots on the back foot, brings both palms together and pushes them toward the right to launch one compact magenta-and-violet sound ring. A short pair of concentric rings stays near the hands. Keep the face, complete body and both shoes visible without duplicated silhouettes or musical-note lettering.
Keep up with the beat, or take a seat.

nodes.title: Character 4 | Nimbus
widgets_values: A newly invented mixed Black and Latina community-garden mother, age 44, medium height with a sturdy curvy build, golden-brown skin, a square kind face, hazel eyes and thick dark-brown braids gathered into a practical compact bun. Plain plum-purple short-sleeve work coveralls with pale blue sleeve cuffs, a broad lavender fabric belt with its ends tucked in, and dark violet rubber rain boots. Empty hands; no plants carried on her clothing, gardening tools, hat, logos or green apparel. Calm determined smile and a balanced natural stance.

Nimbus lowers her center of gravity and extends the forward palm toward the right, forming a compact lavender cloud surrounded by pale blue water droplets. The opposite hand remains tucked near the ribs. Confine all droplets near the attacking palm; do not hide the face or crop either rain boot.
I raised a garden. I can handle a little thunder.

nodes.title: Character 6 | Brick
widgets_values: A newly invented white neighborhood caretaker grandfather, age 63, very tall and broad with a natural square heavyweight build, pale freckled skin, a broad rectangular face, blue-gray eyes, closely cropped silver hair and a thick silver moustache. A plain faded rose-red quilted work vest over a charcoal crewneck long-sleeve shirt, sand-colored work trousers, simple dark-red fabric wrist wraps and chunky charcoal work boots. No tools, hat, badges, logos or writing. A warm stubborn grin, weathered hands and a relaxed wide stance.

Brick braces his wide stance and drives both wrapped hands forward toward the right, launching one compact rose-red block of energy edged in pale gold. The effect resembles a solid pressure wave rather than actual building debris. Preserve one complete fighter, both boots and the entire forward reach inside the sprite cell.
I built this block. Now hold your ground.

nodes.title: Shared art | menus, logo, HUD + effects

widgets_values:
# MUTED REVIEW TEMPLATE

Prepare a new run with node comfyui/tools/prepare-phone-photo-demo.cjs --out output/phone-photo-demo/<fresh-run>. Open the prepared phase1/phase2 UI files; this review template cannot queue model calls.

# Phase 2: phone photos become a complete anime game

49 paid cloud images +22 audio clips, estimated $3.260. Six fictional adults, 162 poses, The Yard and shared artwork. All seven selected uploads must come from THIS run's phase 1: realistic phone images invented from text, never real-person or earlier-session photos. Slots2/3 stay disabled.

The Character Factories use Upload reference, preserving the new fictional faces, hair and everyday outfits as anime identities. Then they generate three sheets, portraits, heroes and cut-ins. The Yard upload drives the playable stage and title/selection venue. Native audio includes music, effects, special calls and six introductions.

## Upload gate and one shared output folder

1. Generate and visually review phase1-ui.json.
2. Download the seven new references and upload them with the exact plan.json filenames.
3. Validate phase2-ui.json or phase2-api.json against that server.
4. Run this graph, then review all18 sheets/162 poses and the audio.

Project Settings supplies one fresh bundle root for assets.json and audio.json. The uploaded synthetic reference photos are preserved as source assets. Keep the existing example/bundle and accepted game separate.
